gloss: to be raised; to come up; to be cited

definitions.gloss: to be brought up; to be cited; to be named
definitions.explanation: Said of names, examples, opinions, or candidates that come up in a discussion. This kanji is the one used when something is put forward for consideration rather than physically rising.

definitions.gloss: to be produced; to be obtained (of results or evidence)
definitions.explanation: Said of results, profits, or evidence that come to hand as the product of effort or investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がった。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がった。
examples.english: Several opinions were raised at the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{決|き}まっていない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: Three names have come up as candidates, but nothing has been decided yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がった。
⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がった。
examples.english: New evidence came to light in the investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がらず、⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Little came of it despite the time spent, so we decided to review our approach.

notes:
One of several kanji written for ⟦あがる→あがる：17309_agaru⟧. {挙|あ}がる is the transitive ⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧'s intransitive partner, used where something is put forward or produced.

CHOOSING THE KANJI:
- ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to go up — the general word for rising
- {挙|あ}がる: to be cited, to be produced — names, examples, results, evidence
- ⟦{揚|あ}がる→揚がる：28726_agaru⟧: to be deep-fried; to be hoisted

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がる: a name comes up
- ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がる: an example is given
- ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がる: results are achieved
- ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{挙|あ}がる: evidence is obtained

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive; the thing raised is marked with が. The transitive partner is ⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧, to give an example).
